metadata.scope_note: Fixture labels are finalized for demo evaluation; this is not a measured Agent accuracy result.

assessment_rules.payment_hypothesis: PAYMENT_ISSUE requires a payment-specific observation or statement. Payment type COD alone, including a vague note merely repeating COD, is not cause evidence; use UNKNOWN_CAUSE when no main cause is supported.
assessment_rules.cod_readiness: For a COD order, include COD_READINESS while current readiness is not established by available sources, even when the main hypothesis is not PAYMENT_ISSUE. Remove it only after supporting information is available.
assessment_rules.missing_info_scope: All unresolved information relevant to rescuing this order, including buyer intent/availability when routed to Ops; not just information needed for the next action.
assessment_rules.logistics: Specific logistics barriers requiring Ops are ESCALATE_REVIEW and NOT_ASKED. Vague traffic/peak notes alone remain UNKNOWN_CAUSE/LOW.
assessment_rules.retired_hold: HOLD_DISRUPTION is legacy catalogue data only. It is excluded from new assessment/policy output enums and workbook active dropdowns.

question_contract.primary_gap_selection: One most important buyer-answerable unresolved gap that can change the recommendation; do not ask a compound or multi-part question.

key_selection.CLARIFY_LANDMARK: Address/landmark/block/access or an address-related barrier at the registered receiving point.
key_selection.CONFIRM_INTENT: Other buyer-side clarification: intent, availability, contact, COD or cause. Classify by the primary purpose in case context.

runner_contract.setup: Reset/clone paired raw seed and process existing NEW case. Never create a duplicate case for the same failed event.
runner_contract.separation: Only simulator/evaluator may read this file. Agent and retrieval receive explicit database raw-input projections only.
runner_contract.question_release: BUYER_REPLY/USER_NO_REPLY require one actual permitted single-focus question, persisted before display. Bind response to actual pending question_id. NOT_ASKED releases no events.
runner_contract.scripted_reply_scope: Expected labels apply to the supplied scripted reply; arbitrary live text is evaluated on its actual facts.
runner_contract.no_reply: No second assessment/policy. Keep initial assessment and initial policy snapshot, but finalize final policy ESCALATED/ESCALATE_REVIEW.
runner_contract.not_asked: No question, reply or question_wait_state. Finalize from ASSESSED with initial assessment and policy, source=1.

final_policy_output.reason: order_rescue.reason

evaluation_rules.missing_info: Unordered set of approved relevant unresolved codes, including full buyer+logistics gaps in Ops cases. [] is distinct from null assessment.
evaluation_rules.evidence: Validate availability, factual meaning and provenance; every source_ref resolves. No verbatim, order or array-length requirement.
evaluation_rules.question: Expected count is 0 for NOT_ASKED and 1 otherwise. Ask only one primary_missing_info goal; semantic relevance and broad key mapping matter, not verbatim text. Reject compound/multi-part questions.
evaluation_rules.reason: Semantic policy facts and conditions, not verbatim text.
evaluation_rules.final_policy: BUYER_REPLY copies policy 2; NOT_ASKED copies policy 1; USER_NO_REPLY after CLARIFY applies final review without modifying policy 1.
behavior: No second question or third assessment
No forced confidence boost from intent alone
No HOLD_DISRUPTION or real logistics execution
evaluation_rules.not_measured: No actual Agent accuracy, live carrier-policy certification or shipment success measurement.
